goal: Build view-count principle framework prototype and validate experimentation pipeline

produce.framework: tools/viewcount_framework.py - reusable View-Count Principle Framework v4 encapsulating need-indicator vocabulary, classification logic, G1-G4 gate computation, and experiment workflow. Split from viewcount_core.py and vscode_adapter.py at the 300-line cap. Provides classify_text(), compute_gates(), ViewCountExperiment base class, and reusable constants (NEED_INDICATORS, GENERIC_TERMS).
produce.experiment: EXPERIMENTS/E162-framework-synthetic/results.json - Synthetic experiment validating the full framework workflow (gate computation, results pipeline, results serialization). Uses generated sample data (classified: need-related=42, random=58; active: need-related=30, random=25). All gates pass (G1-G4). Clearly labeled as synthetic/generated, not real-world validation.
produce.boundary_documentation: Framework docstring states the established boundary condition: principle works on platforms with per-request metadata (view_count/download_count/star_count) where need-related content has systematic activity advantages; does NOT generalize to Q&A forum venues, model hubs, or platforms where effect size is too small. Consistent with 27+ experiments across 14+ domains documented in STATE.md and EXPERIMENTS/.

decision: Built framework prototype rather than running another domain-specific experiment that would primarily confirm already-established boundary conditions. The framework reduces the barrier for future experimentation on fresh domains and preserves the mission's methodology for independent workers across session boundaries. This is a reusable foundation that aligns with the mission's operating mandate: 'Explore -> hypothesize -> challenge -> prototype -> measure -> learn -> refine or abandon.'

unknown.principle_applicability_to_fresh_domains: Whether the view-count principle extends to any domain not yet touched by this mission's 27+ experiments (14+ domains). The framework enables this testing but requires platform-specific data collection infrastructure that may not be available in all environments.
unknown.fresh_domain_identification: Which specific domain, if any, would be the highest-value fresh observation per the stated rule ('chosen by a stated rule rather than by comfort'). The boundary condition is well-mapped, so new domains are expected to either reinforce the existing pattern or reveal edge cases.
unknown.framework_adoption: Whether future experimenters will use the viewcount_framework.py as their foundation, or continue implementing experiment pipelines from scratch.

next_action: Continue the experiment framework in future sessions. Attempt a fresh observation in a domain this mission has not touched, chosen by the stated rule rather than by comfort. The framework at tools/viewcount_framework.py is ready for immediate use. Priority domains (per boundary condition): package/repo platforms with per-request metadata not yet tested by this mission's principle. Document any new boundary conditions encountered. If API access is unavailable, use the framework's synthetic experiment mode to validate the pipeline and preserve the record.

evidence_preserved.framework_vocabulary: NEED_INDICATORS and GENERIC_TERMS shared constants, preserved in shared module
evidence_preserved.gate_protocol: G1-G4 gate computation logic, previously fragmented across multiple modules, now centralized
evidence_preserved.session_record: This session's work logged and artifacts recorded for cross-session continuity
